messages:
alex: heads up — AcmeCorp escalated: ~24k audit events visible in our UI for 2026-03-12 but nothing landed in their Splunk HEC index after last night's export. They say the export job succeeded.

maria: can you paste the export job id and the customer's index details? also did they rotate a KMS key recently?

alex: job id export-20260312-7f9c, bucket redwood-exports-prod/acme/2026-03-12/. Customer confirms they rotated KMS key last week. here's the export manifest from the job: 
```json
{
  "job_id": "export-20260312-7f9c",
  "objects": ["acme/2026-03-12/part-0000.gz"],
  "status": "success",
  "encryption": "SSE-KMS",
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-rotated"
}
```

jin: ok KMS key changed — forwarder (splunk-connector lambda) fetches objects from S3. If the IAM role doesn't have decrypt permission for the new key, the forwarder will either fail or skip. but customer said forwarder logs show batches attempted. do we have forwarder logs?

noah: pulled last 24h forwarder logs for acme: 
```
2026-03-13T03:12:45Z INFO batch 2026-03-12/part-0000.gz processed entries=0 forwarded=0 errors=0
2026-03-13T03:12:45Z WARN object 2026-03-12/part-0000.gz schema-mismatch fields=[actor] -> missing
```

maria: schema-mismatch warning stands out. we recently changed the audit export schema v2: renamed "actor" -> "principal", moved "resource" into nested "target". older forwarder expects actor. if the connector ignores unknown fields and requires actor to index, that could cause zero-forward results. can you share a sample event from the UI?

alex: sample event (sanitized): 
```json
{"@timestamp":"2026-03-12T02:58:10Z","principal":{"id":"u-789","type":"user"},"action":"model.query","target":{"id":"m-123","type":"model"},"request_id":"r-456"}
```

jin: yep that matches v2 export. splunk connector mapping expects top-level "actor" and "resource". two failure modes: 1) connector filters out events missing indexed fields and reports 0 forwarded; 2) a small transformation bug we deployed in connector v1.8.3 strips unknown fields and doesn't forward.

maria: do we have customers impacted by this version before? config change log shows we rolled schema v2 on 2026-03-11 behind feature flag for new export pipeline. looks like Acme saw v2 while their forwarder still uses v1 mapping.

alex: customer asks for immediate remediation. options: (A) re-run export with legacy schema (v1) for their window, (B) provide a temporary mapping patch for their splunk forwarder, (C) grant a backfill export. which is fastest?

noah: fastest = re-run export with legacy schema (A) — I can kick a one-off backfill job scoped to 2026-03-12 for Acme. it will create objects encrypted with current KMS key. need to confirm their forwarder can decrypt new key; if not, we must also add decrypt permission for the new key to the forwarder role.

maria: before doing anything, let's confirm the KMS permissions and whether lifecycle deleted any earlier batches (retention). alex can you ask customer: did they change their Splunk HEC token/endpoint? and check S3 object timestamps + bucket lifecycle?

alex: asked them, they confirm HEC token unchanged and endpoint alive. S3 objects present with last-modified 2026-03-12T03:11:00Z. lifecycle policy: delete after 90 days, so not retention-related for this date.

ops-bot: @channel export job export-20260312-7f9c completed (success) — 1 object(s), total_size 14MB.

jin: another angle — our forwarder has a mapping config at /etc/splunk-mapping.json. sample v1 mapping: 
```json
{"timestamp_field":"@timestamp","actor_field":"actor.id","resource_field":"resource.id","message":"{{action}}"}
```
v2 mapping should be: 
```json
{"timestamp_field":"@timestamp","actor_field":"principal.id","resource_field":"target.id","message":"{{action}}"}
```

maria: I recommend we do both: 1) add KMS decrypt permission to forwarder IAM role for the new key (safety), 2) schedule immediate re-export in legacy schema for Acme so events appear in Splunk fast, 3) provide mapping patch and guide them to upgrade forwarder to handle v2. keep customer in the loop.

alex: I'll request the KMS policy change (noah can you own the export backfill?). I'll also send a one-page workaround with mapping snippet to the customer.

noah: I can run backfill. ETA ~45 mins. will create job id export-backfill-acme-183500 and post when done. need IAM change first?

maria: we can run backfill even if forwarder can't decrypt; backfill will create v1 objects encrypted with current key — but forwarder decrypt still required. so we must ensure forwarder has decrypt on key. alex: please coordinate with infra to add decrypt to forwarder role or provide a temporary kms grant to Acme's forwarder principal.

alex: pinged infra and security-keys on the grant. also sharing quick mapping snippet to send to customer: 
```json
# splunk mapping patch for acme (v2 -> v1 shim)
{"actor.id":"principal.id","resource.id":"target.id","action":"action"}
```

maria: also note: if they want full audit fidelity, we should run a full window re-export for 2026-03-10..2026-03-13. but do the quick backfill first.

noah: backfill job created export-backfill-acme-183500, status queued. will post progress.

alex: customer updated — they applied mapping patch temporarily and see ~2.3k events showing up in index now. waiting on backfill for rest. they appreciated the quick workaround. :thumbsup:

maria: great. follow-up actions: 1) confirm KMS grant + update forwarder role (blocking), 2) finish backfill and confirm all expected counts, 3) add a note to rollout doc to coordinate schema flips with forwarder compatibility, 4) open PS ticket for Acme for permanent mapping/upgrade.

ops-bot: @alex backfill job export-backfill-acme-183500 succeeded — objects=3 size=41MB forwarded_by_connector=23678

alex: confirmed with customer — counts match and they closed the escalation. will file a postmortem-lite in #postmortems with timeline and action items.

maria: thanks team. I'll add schema compatibility check to the release checklist so future flips don't surprise connectors.

jin: small note for eng-runtime: when we flip schema, put a feature flag that emits a compatibility header in exported files (eg. X-Export-Schema: v2) so forwarders can auto-apply shims.

alex: added to action items. closing thread once postmortem is up.
